texts: This indeed he brings forward naturally. But this I will put my trust in Him 2 Samuel 22:3, what does it mean? For what follows this is also [introduced] naturally. Behold, I and the children which God has given Me. 385 8:18 For as here He shows Himself a Father, so before, a Brother. I will declare Your name unto My brethren, He says.

entries.e: But this I will put my trust in Him
